$comment: Site-wide rule ids and one-line statements; prose in playbook/site/site-rules.md.

rules.site.header.rendered: Header template renders with its stylesheet, logo, navigation, Contact Us; footer renders.
rules.site.layout.viewport: No horizontal overflow beyond 160px, header overlap under 48px/25%, no clipped text, CTAs inside viewport on desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844.
rules.site.layout.images: Visible images render; staff photos do not clip faces.
rules.site.layout.console: Under 20 console errors on critical routes.
rules.site.brand.copy: MacKenzie's recorded copy rules; four held items untouched.
rules.site.identity.sister-brand: No sister-brand names in page-owned content except the Brownsville/Nova exception.
rules.site.identity.other-campus: No other campus referenced in image names, alt text, links, packets, calendars, schema.
rules.site.seasonal.window: Seasonal CTAs only inside the approved window; launch statements name month/season and year.
rules.site.search.indexable: robots reachable, sitemap populated, critical routes indexable with canonical, no duplicate titles/canonicals, valid JSON-LD, Googlebot parity.
rules.site.search.ai-files: AI discovery files reachable and non-empty.
rules.site.search.schema: Campus School schema with URL, address, coordinates within 1 mile of source.
rules.site.claims.evidence: Statistics and named-entity claims exist in the claim registry with evidence.
rules.site.events.sync: Public HubSpot events appear on /upcoming-events/ and the campus strip within 2 hours; registration links resolve; facts match; sister-brand events excluded.
rules.site.map.integrity: Maps render; each program once with correct label, status, coordinates, destination; pre-announcement pins route to Community; no scroll trap.

site.community.routing.statement: Community destinations use campus=<verified Community slug>, joined by exact HubSpot program id to a visible Community record; unknown or ambiguous mappings fail closed.
site.community.routing.source: Deployed Community app program registry and router inspected 2026-09-16
site.community.routing.check: tests/validate-community-routing.mjs; production observer parameter coverage is advisory until updated

rules.site.loop.health: Source providers and snapshots healthy (not a website change).

site.sync.no-hand-edit-of-synced-targets.statement: An Elementor element whose CSS ID is in the n8n field map, or whose value originates in a HubSpot Program property, is never hand-edited as a durable fix; the value is corrected in HubSpot and the sync runs. hubspot_event posts are never created or edited by hand.
site.sync.no-hand-edit-of-synced-targets.check: page-check n8n-target-guard (to build); MCP unrelated-path guard

site.sync.layout-keeps-css-ids.statement: A layout change on a campus page keeps every CSS ID the n8n workflow expects, and the SEO Template page is updated with any approved layout change, because new campus drafts are cloned from it.
site.sync.layout-keeps-css-ids.check: manual until the CSS ID inventory is confirmed

site.accessibility.proposed-baseline.statement: Proposed WCAG 2.2 AA baseline covering semantic headings, alt text, accessible names, keyboard operation, visible focus, contrast, forms, captions and reduced motion.
site.accessibility.proposed-baseline.source: Audit remediation proposal dated 2026-09-17; named approval still required

site.performance.proposed-baseline.statement: Record before and after performance evidence for global and media-heavy changes; do not add unowned global weight; numeric Core Web Vitals budgets require approval.
site.performance.proposed-baseline.check: manual baseline comparison until budgets are approved

site.browser.proposed-baseline.statement: Verify current Chrome, Safari, iPhone Safari and Android Chrome for presentation work; Firefox and Edge for global navigation, forms and templates until support policy is approved.

site.media.proposed-standard.statement: Every asset records rights, owner, identity, source hash, filename, title, alt text, slot, crop, dimensions, focal point and seasonal window when applicable.
site.media.proposed-standard.source: Alpha MCP media safety contract plus audit remediation proposal
site.media.proposed-standard.check: media registry validator to build after approval
